final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, b.overall_avg FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE ca.avg_wins > b.overall_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT ao.country, ao.avg_wins AS average, ao.avg_wins - ao.overall_avg AS above_overall_benchmark, ao.avg_wins - sm.avg_wins AS above_second_mean FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE ao.avg_wins > sm.avg_wins
